paper_title: 基于两种新颖辅助任务的端到端语音翻译
caption_used: 图表展示了不同超参数设置对BLEU分数的影响，包含两个子图。左图中横轴为知识蒸馏权重α，范围从0.1到0.9；右图中横轴为掩码概率p，范围从0.05到0.45。两图纵轴均为BLEU得分，范围从28.0到28.6。左图显示α=0.5时BLEU达到峰值约28.53，α=0.1时最低约27.95。右图中p=0.15时BLEU达到峰值约28.53。值得注意的是，参数p对BLEU分数的影响幅度明显大于α，p在0.25处出现显著下降至约28.1后又回升，表明模型对掩码概率的选择更为敏感；相较之下α的影响曲线则较为平缓对称。
model_annotation: Both graphs share the same y-axis, which is labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale, and ranges from 28.0 to 28.6, with a numerical tick interval of 0.1. The left graph displays a single blue line with circular markers and a solid line style, representing the BLEU score as a function of "α" on the x-axis, which has a linear scale and ranges from 0.1 to 0.9  with a numerical tick interval of 0.2. The line starts at approximately 27.98 when α is 0.1, increases to a peak of around 28.53 when α is 0.5, and then decreases to about 28.1 when α is 0.9. The right graph also displays a single blue line with circular markers and a solid line style, showing the BLEU score as a function of "p" on the x-axis, which has a linear scale and ranges from 0.05 to 0.45 with a numerical tick interval of 0.1. The line begins at around 28.3 when p is 0.05, peaks at approximately 28.53 when p is 0.15, dips to about 28.4 when p is 0.25, and then rises slightly to around 28.45 when p is 0.35 before decreasing to about 28.4 when p is 0.45.
